{text:body}

Ipswich is full of old Queenslanders and workers' cottages, and many still have their original corrugated iron. In Booval, Brassall and Raceview we re-roof a lot of these homes, and on heritage and character streets we match the original profile and colour so the house still suits its neighbours. Some older Ipswich homes also have asbestos cement sheeting in the eaves or roof. We check for it before we quote, and if it has to come out we bring in a licensed removalist. Out at Ripley and Redbank Plains the homes are much newer, and the jobs there are mostly storm damage, blocked box gutters and flashings that were never sealed well. Ipswich summers run hotter than Brisbane's, and a tin roof with nothing under it turns the house into an oven. When we re-roof we can add sarking and insulation at the same time, and we fit whirlybirds to any roof.
